_comment: GEO prompt set for klaussa.com: prompts a real Indonesian user would plausibly ask an LLM, where Klaussa should ideally be cited. The 'weekly' tier runs on every GEO run; 'monthly' prompts are added only in months whose budget.json entry allows it. Grounded in real GSC query clusters, not invented. Do not edit mid-month -- the POC compares week 1 vs week 4 using an identical prompt set, so a change here invalidates the comparison.
